chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his late twenties with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a new slim navy-blue suit with a white shirt and no tie
chars.DAD: a Moroccan father in his late fifties with grey hair, grey moustache and glasses, wearing a cream-colored traditional jabador with a brown cardigan over it
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a dark green kaftan and a beige headscarf
chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman in her mid twenties with long wavy brown hair, wearing an elegant light pink kaftan with golden embroidery

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan salon with long sedari sofas and zellige details during an engagement visit. DAD suddenly stands up from the sofa with a stern closed face, while NARRATOR, sitting next to him holding a bouquet of red roses, looks up at him confused and MOM stares at DAD surprised. Hosts' family blurred on the opposite sofa. A silver tea tray lies tipped over on the carpet.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon, DAD firmly pushes a bouquet of red roses and a box of chocolates back into the arms of NARRATOR, pointing with his other hand toward the door. NARRATOR, mouth open, completely lost.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon doorway, GIRL stands frozen with her hands over her mouth, eyes wet, a fallen tea tray and spilled glasses at her feet. NARRATOR in the foreground (seen from behind at shoulder level, turning his head toward her) looks at her bewildered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, a Moroccan apartment building entrance in Casablanca. DAD walks out fast in front with a hard face, MOM follows worried, NARRATOR behind them carrying the roses and chocolate box, looking back over his shoulder at the building, confused.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a car on a Casablanca street, seen through the windshield. DAD in the passenger seat stares ahead silently, rubbing his forehead as if in shock. NARRATOR driving glances at him, puzzled. City lights in the background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, back seat of the car, NARRATOR in his suit looks down at his glowing phone with a worried face, the roses lying on the seat next to him. The phone screen is seen only as light, no readable content.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan family living room at night with a low round table. DAD sits on the sofa and firmly gestures for NARRATOR to sit down in front of him. NARRATOR, still in his suit, slowly sits, anxious.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night, warm lamp light. Medium shot: DAD leans forward and talks seriously, one finger raised, a heavy secretive look on his face. NARRATOR listens, eyes wide, frozen.
